job_title: Gauteng Dept of Health: Nursing Traineeship Programme 2027
about_role:
Location: Gauteng
Applicants are invited to apply to the Gauteng College of Nursing to study towards the Diploma in Nursing in 2027 at one of the College campuses: • Ann Latsky Campus • Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus • SG Lourens Campus • Bonalesedi Campus.
To successfully apply and be considered for the training, please take note of the following:
• You are required to register a profile on the system before you can apply.
• Must be a South African citizen, who resides in the Gauteng Province.
• You must be in possession of one of the following school leaving certificates – a Senior Certificate, a National Senior Certificate, currently in Grade 12 or National Vocational Certificate Primary Health
• Applications must be done on the GPG Professional Job Centre system before or on the 26th September;NO late applications will be accepted
• Documents will be uploaded on the system, however you will be required to take supporting documents to the selection centre should you be shortlisted.
• No hand delivered or emailed applications will be accepted, all applications must be done online.
The following subject criteria are required:
• Senior Certificate: English HG D or SG C, Biology HG D or SG C, Mathematics HG D or SG C and an M score of 17
• National Senior Certificate: English Level 4, Life Sciences Level 4, Mathematics Level 4 or Maths Literacy Level 5, and an APS of 27 or more (Life Orientation counts half the score)
• National Vocational Certificate: 50% in Fundamental Subjects (English First Additional Language, Maths/Maths Literacy, Life Orientation) and 60% in the Vocational Subjects (SA Health Care System, Public Health, The Human Body and Mind and Community Oriented Primary Care)
• Current Grade 12 learners must meet the National Senior Certificate requirements in their Grade 11 final results.
COMPETENCIES AND ATTRIBUTES:
Passion for nursing, Problem-solving ability • Patience • Ability to relate to people • Organisational ability • Leadership ability • Flexibility • Calmness during a crisis • Communication, numeracy and life skills • Computer literacy • Study skills • Honesty • Compassionate and caring.
NOTES:
All short-listed applicants will undergo a compulsory psychometric assessment. Successful applicants on psychometric assessment will be required to undergo medical surveillance, including a physical examination and verification of all documentation.
Applicants are required to scan and upload their Senior/National Senior/ National Certificate (Vocational) or statement of Grade 12 results or final Grade 11 results. Candidates can apply via the following link: https://nursingintake.gauteng.gov.za. Completion of all processes during the recruitment and selection process does not guarantee final selection on the programme.
Successful applicants will be required:
• To sign an agreement with the Gauteng Department of Health ,
• Attend lectures. Be prepared to participate in Work Integrated Learning (WIL) which includes shifts and working on public holidays, weekends and nights in Gauteng Department of Health hospitals and clinics as part of the program requirements.
PLEASE NOTE:
• Ensure that you qualify and meet the minimum requirements before you apply you do not receive feedback within 3 months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.

With more than 34400 students, and approximately 1700 members of staff, the Durban University of Technology (DUT) is a leading university of technology proudly located in the beautiful cities of Durban and Pietermaritzburg, along the warm east coast of South Africa. Founded in April 2002 through the historic merger of the former ML Sultan Technikon and Technikon Natal, DUT has evolved into a modern, metropolitan, multi-campus university with roots tracing back to 1907.
Today, DUT is recognised nationally and internationally for its excellence in teaching and learning, research, innovation, entrepreneurship and engagement. A proud member of the International Association of Universities, DUT continues to expand its influence across South Africa and the world. In the 2025 Webometrics Rankings, DUT was ranked among the Top 6% of all universities and colleges worldwide, reflecting its academic excellence, research impact and strong global visibility.
DUT’s Philosophy of Education, “Our creativity and innovation shapes adaptive graduates who transform society” reflects the institution’s deep commitment to meaningful impact for societal transformation. Guided by its inspirational and aspirational ENVISION2030 strategy, which is rooted in DUT’s DNA of being ‘people-centred and engaged’ and ‘innovative and entrepreneurial’ and underpinned by its bespoke Living Values Framework, DUT focuses on ‘contributing to the improving lives and livelihoods’.
The University comprises six diverse Faculties:
• Accounting and Informatics
• Applied Sciences
• Arts & Design
• Engineering and the Built Environment
• Health Sciences
• Management SciencesDUT also includes a Business School and the award-winning Institute for Water and Wastewater Technology (IWWT), amongst other research centres and institutes, reinforcing its role as a hub for knowledge, innovation and societal impact. DUT is deeply engaged with its community and regional ecosystem, while remaining globally connected and relevant.
At DUT, we believe in nurturing talent and empowering people to make a real difference. If you are passionate about contributing to education, research, innovation, entrepreneurship and engagement, DUT offers the ideal environment - Creative. Distinctive. Impactful.

With more than 34400 students, and approximately 1700 members of staff, the Durban University of Technology (DUT) is a leading university of technology proudly located in the beautiful cities of Durban and Pietermaritzburg, along the warm east coast of South Africa. Founded in April 2002 through the historic merger of the former ML Sultan Technikon and Technikon Natal, DUT has evolved into a modern, metropolitan, multi-campus university with roots tracing back to 1907.
Today, DUT is recognised nationally and internationally for its excellence in teaching and learning, research, innovation, entrepreneurship and engagement. A proud member of the International Association of Universities, DUT continues to expand its influence across South Africa and the world. In the 2025 Webometrics Rankings, DUT was ranked among the Top 6% of all universities and colleges worldwide, reflecting its academic excellence, research impact and strong global visibility.
DUT’s Philosophy of Education, “Our creativity and innovation shapes adaptive graduates who transform society” reflects the institution’s deep commitment to meaningful impact for societal transformation. Guided by its inspirational and aspirational ENVISION2030 strategy, which is rooted in DUT’s DNA of being ‘people-centred and engaged’ and ‘innovative and entrepreneurial’ and underpinned by its bespoke Living Values Framework, DUT focuses on ‘contributing to the improving lives and livelihoods’.
The University comprises six diverse Faculties:
• Accounting and Informatics
• Applied Sciences
• Arts & Design
• Engineering and the Built Environment
• Health Sciences
• Management SciencesDUT also includes a Business School and the award-winning Institute for Water and Wastewater Technology (IWWT), amongst other research centres and institutes, reinforcing its role as a hub for knowledge, innovation and societal impact. DUT is deeply engaged with its community and regional ecosystem, while remaining globally connected and relevant.
At DUT, we believe in nurturing talent and empowering people to make a real difference. If you are passionate about contributing to education, research, innovation, entrepreneurship and engagement, DUT offers the ideal environment - Creative. Distinctive. Impactful.

Manage the allocated debtors’ book by collecting payments on or before they are due and minimizing bad debts by following internal policies and procedures. Establish and maintain excellent relationships with all internal and external parties through constant communication. Work in line with credit legislation. Resolving account-related queries with a matter of urgency and maintaining an elevated level of customer service on all matters related to Accounts Receivable.
Credit Controller Duties and Responsibilities
Banking and Payment Allocations:
• Checking the various bank statements daily to identify payments made for the debtors assigned to the credit controller.
• Capturing the payment receipt on the ERP system.
• Allocating the payment according to the official remittance from the partner or an email from the partner advising which invoices to clear with the specific payment. Payments may NEVER be allocated from the oldest invoices forward UNLESS the credit controller has written confirmation from the Finance manager at the partner’s company.
• Save the payment batch in the specified folder for auditing purposes in line with the payment allocation process.
• If the credit controller has no remittance or instruction email on how to allocate the payment at the time the payment shows on the bank statement, the credit controller must phone and email the partner for the remittance or payment instructions. The credit controller will follow up on the remittance or payment instruction email daily for 2 days, and then the AR Supervisor must request the remittance or payment instruction email from the partner.
• If a remittance or payment instruction email is still not received on day 3 after the payment was received on the account, the credit controller will send a debtor’s aging ledger to the partner, marking which invoices will be cleared with the specific payment, and will then email it to the partner advising that allocation will take place accordingly. Payments allocated in this manner will not be reversed later when a remittance or payment instruction is received.Customer Statements:
• As soon as the Group Credit & AR Manager confirms all statements have been sent after month-end closure, the Credit controller will check System1A daily to ensure that the partners have viewed their statements.
• If the partner has not viewed their statement after the 3rd day, the credit controller will phone and email the partner to confirm the statement link was received and check if it was sent to junk mail or blocked.
• If the partner confirms that the statement has still not been received, the credit controller will resend a statement and ask the partner to confirm receiptInvoices, PODs, Credit notes, and Other Supporting Documents:
• The credit controller must send out Invoices, PODs, Credit notes, and all other supporting documents as and when required by the partner.
• The credit controller must then also educate the partner to use System1A so that they may access any required documents from that system in the future.

• This feedback will be consolidated by the AR Supervisor and sent to the Group Credit and AR Manager no later than COB on Wednesday.Queries:

Purpose of the Role:
The FAIS Supervisor plays a key role in supporting the Key Individual (“KI”) by ensuring that all
external agents, quality assurance agents or call centre agents adhere to the requirements as
provided for in the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act (“FAIS”). The role reports
directly to the Head of Legal and Compliance, though the FAIS Supervisor will be trained and
managed by the KI, gaining valuable experience and mentorship with a view to ultimately
transition into a future KI role. The Supervisor will act as the primary line of defense in
conjunction with the Quality Assurance Team in identifying and addressing any compliance
issues within sales practices, reviewing the effectiveness of the Quality Assurance processes,
ensuring that the KI's strategic oversight is well-supported with accurate and consistent
monitoring.
This role ensures that sales practices across all distribution channels meet legal standards,
thereby protecting the company from legal risks and ensuring that all agents operate ethically
and within regulatory boundaries.
The FAIS Supervisor is essential in maintaining the integrity of the supervisory process and
ensuring that all agents meet the required competencies to be fully independent.
Role Summary:
As the FAIS Supervisor, you will take on the direct supervision of agents, regularly evaluating
their sales activities to ensure they meet the FAIS requirements and other regulatory
standards.
Your primary focus will be to ensure that agents comply with legal requirements, avoid
misrepresentation, and protect customers from mis-selling. You will conduct monthly
competency assessments, review sales practices, and ensure ongoing compliance, providing
the KI with detailed reports and feedback on agent performance. This data will be crucial for
the KI to assess agent competency, identify training needs, and make informed decision.
You will play a key role in maintaining the integrity of the compliance process, ensuring clear
communication with both agents and the KI about performance and compliance issues. By
thoroughly assessing sales processes, offering coaching, and identifying areas for
improvement, you will help the KI mitigate regulatory risks and create an environment where
agents can succeed, achieve their goals, and positively impact the lives of our customers.
Benefits:
• The right candidate will have a clear path for growth into a KI role, with the opportunity to
work closely alongside the KI and Head of Legal and Compliance. This collaboration will
provide valuable hands-on experience in compliance leadership and regulatory oversight.
• Ongoing mentorship and training in regulatory compliance, enhancing skills for future
leadership roles.Key Responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance Oversight:
• Ensure that all call centre agents adhere to the requirements in FAIS and other regulatory
requirements by monitoring their daily activities, reviewing sales interactions, and
confirming that legal standards are met.Competency Assessments:
• Development of Supervision Plans for each agent requiring supervision.
• Conduct monthly competency evaluations of agents, assessing their ability to comply with
FAIS requirements, demonstrating ethical sales practices, and identifying areas for
improvement.Sales Activity Monitoring:
• Review and evaluate a sample of sales calls and transactions, ensuring compliance with
FAIS and preventing misrepresentation or mis-selling. Ensure that agents meet all legal
and ethical sales requirements.Reporting and Feedback:
• Prepare detailed compliance reports for the KI, summarizing the results of your
assessments and feedback on agent performance. Provide actionable recommendations
for ongoing training and improvements.Communication with Agents:
• Deliver clear and constructive feedback to agents, outlining areas for improvement and
reinforcing compliance standards. Set specific expectations for performance, ensuring
alignment with regulatory requirements.Agent Development and Training:

performance. Assist in the development of agents so they can eventually transition from
supervision to independent operation.Documentation and Record Keeping:
• Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all assessments, evaluations, and feedback
sessions, ensuring proper documentation for compliance reviews and audits with
company compliance strategies and address any compliance concerns or issues.
Risk Mitigation:
• Identify potential compliance risks and proactively recommend corrective actions to
minimise legal exposure. Support the KI in addressing compliance issues and maintaining
the company’s reputation for legal and ethical conduct.Technical Skills:
• Strong understanding of FAIS, compliance requirements, and other applicable financial
services regulations.
• High level of proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and Word, to analyse data,
generate reports, and document compliance activities.
• Skilled in reviewing sales processes to spot any compliance issues and suggest practical
improvements.
Soft Skills:
• Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively provide feedback to Agents,
Team Leaders, Supervisors, and preparation of detailed compliance reports for the KI.
• A meticulous approach to reviewing sales activities, identifying compliance risks, and
ensuring accuracy in reporting.
• Commitment to upholding high standards of integrity and ethical conduct, especially
when dealing with sensitive compliance matters.
• Demonstrated capacity for leading, mentoring, and coaching agents while ensuring

Handling of Cargo
• Meet and greet the customer from the ramp and assist with offloading their cargo.

Our client, a global company operating in the fruit industry and situated in Paarl (Western Cape), has an exciting career opportunity for a Cost Accountant to join their team.
This is a hybrid role that requires 2–3 office days per week.
The ideal candidate is analytical and detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving, organisational and communication skills, and the ability to build effective working relationships while driving continuous improvement.
The successful candidate will take responsibility for managing and optimising the organisation's product, inventory and production costs.
KPI’s will include (but not be limited to):
• Cost Management & Cost Analysis: Reviewing operational and production costs; developing and maintaining costing models; analysing profitability, margins and cost variances; identifying cost reduction opportunities and recommending operational improvements.
• Inventory Accounting & Valuation: Maintaining inventory costing methodologies; reviewing inventory valuations; coordinating stock counts; investigating inventory variances; monitoring inventory provisions; ensuring accurate cost of goods sold reporting.
• Budgeting & Forecasting: Supporting annual budgets and forecasts; preparing departmental cost budgets; monitoring budget performance; assisting with scenario planning and strategic cost projections.
• Management Reporting: Preparing monthly cost and profitability reports; producing operational performance reports; presenting cost analyses and financial insights; monitoring financial and operational KPIs.
• Capital Expenditure & Investment Analysis: Evaluating capital expenditure proposals; conducting cost-benefit and return-on-investment analyses; monitoring approved capital projects; supporting investment decisions.
• Continuous Improvement & Process Optimisation: Identifying process improvement opportunities; enhancing costing procedures and controls; supporting system improvements; improving reporting capabilities and costing methodologies.
• Internal Controls & Governance: Maintaining inventory and costing controls; reviewing costing processes; ensuring compliance with company policies and accounting standards; supporting internal and external audits.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Partnering with operational and commercial teams; supporting management with financial analysis; communicating cost information; building cross-functional relationships.
Essential qualifications, skills, and experience:
• BCom degree in Accounting, Management Accounting, Cost Accounting or an equivalent qualification required; registration with CIMA, SAIPA, SAICA or a related professional body will be advantageous;
• Experience in Cost or Management Accounting, including costing models, inventory accounting, budgeting and forecasting, operational and production cost analysis, and management reporting;
• Experience in the agricultural industry and within a multinational company environment will be preferred; experience in manufacturing, FMCG, export-focused business, and project management will be advantageous;
• Strong computer proficiency (Advanced MS Excel, ERP and financial reporting systems).

Atlantis, Cape Town
Salary: R45,000 – R55,000 CTC per month
Our client, a well-established manufacturer in the plastic injection moulding industry, is looking for an experienced, hands-on Production Manager to lead their production team at their Atlantis facility.

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, enjoys being on the factory floor, and has extensive experience in plastic injection moulding, including machine setting and production optimisation. The successful candidate will be supported by a Production Administrator, allowing them to focus on driving production, quality, efficiency, and team performance.

• Manage the day-to-day operations of the production department.
• Lead and motivate production staff to achieve daily production targets.
• Set up and optimise injection moulding machines for maximum efficiency.

• Ensure products meet quality standards and customer specifications.
• Monitor production output, waste, cycle times, and machine efficiencies.
• Plan and coordinate production schedules.
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and company procedures.
• Work closely with maintenance to minimise equipment downtime.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives throughout the factory.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and well-organised production environment.

Orientation towards an industrial / manufacturing environment & previous experience in the compressor industry would be a plus. Based in ALRODE, an industrial area in Alberton, Johannesburg South & transport must not be an issue.
A strong work ethic, performance driven with stable work history are valued attributes.

Overview - Role requires an individual who communicates effectively with customers, suppliers & colleagues, addresses their concerns and ensures a seamless exerience with their products and services. Strong problem-solving skills & a customer-centric approach is necessary. You would be performing clerical / administrative support duties for the sales & purchasing departments. Prepare & distribute various sales reports when required. Maintain customer & supplier files, assist sales team & handle inquiries about products or services. Project a professional company image through all interactions.

Customer Interation -  Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email and online channels regarding required services and parts. Check & assist with reviewing internal costings leading to preparing customer quotations.

Issue Resolution - Handle customer complaints or issues, escalating to the appropriate department when necessary, while maintaining a professional and positive demeanor.
Sales Support - Assist with upselling parts, service agreements, and additional products based on customer needs.
Documentation - Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, transactions, inquiries, and complaints in relevant systems.
Collaboration - Work closely with the sales, technical support, and stores teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of products and services as well as controlling/maintaining stock levels in relation to open sales orders and customer contracts. Liase with the workshop  regarding processing of Job cards/picking lists and production orders.
Follow-up - Proactively follow up on customer satisfaction, order status and any post-purchase support needs.

We are an established health and wellness ecommerce brand looking for a top-tier Ad Editor to join our team long term. This is not a short contract or a one-off project. We are building a brand for the long run and want serious talent that is ready to grow with us.
If you care about performance, creative testing, and producing ads that convert at scale, this role is for you.
As our Ad Editor, you will be responsible for editing high-performing video ads used across paid traffic channels. You will work directly from detailed ad briefs and turn raw assets into compelling, conversion-focused creatives. Your role is to take raw footage and assets and turn them into ads that are designed to hold attention, communicate clearly, and drive conversions.
This position requires strong technical editing skills and a solid understanding of direct response advertising. You must be responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable making revisions based on feedback and performance data. Once an edit is delivered, you are expected to stay in communication and make updates quickly when needed.
This is a long-term position with a stable monthly salary and additional performance bonuses tied to winning ads. As the brand continues to scale, there is opportunity for long-term growth and increased responsibility.
The ideal candidate has experience editing ecommerce ads and understands how performance-driven advertising works. You should be able to follow creative direction precisely, work efficiently, and deliver assets on time. You must be open to feedback, able to handle revisions professionally, and committed to building a long-term working relationship with one brand.
If you are a serious Ad Editor looking for consistent work, performance-based upside, and the opportunity to grow with an health and wellness brand, we want to hear from you.

About Exchange Life
Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.
You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine — you'll own that side of the creative machine.
What Success Looks Like
Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process — creatives that pass review without rework and match the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.
Core Responsibilities
• Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows
• Overlay headlines and copy in Photoshop, matching Exchange Life's visual style
• Iterate on designs based on feedback from the team and ad performance
• Organize and manage creative assets, keeping our AI image library clean and up to date
• Communicate proactively about bottlenecks, capacity, and output

About Exchange Life
Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. We run a fully remote content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across the world.
We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals — not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us for 2+ years.
You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.
What Success Looks Like
After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form videos that scale on ads and organic — 50%+ thumb-stop rates, 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.
Core Responsibilities
• Edit TikTok and Reels content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time — not just aesthetics
• Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes
• Collaborate with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on winning formats
• Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day — no check-ins required
• Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

job_title: Full-Time Remote Video Editor — AI Video Ads (Kling + AI Tools) for a US Ecommerce Brand
about_role:
FULL-TIME REMOTE VIDEO EDITOR — AI VIDEO ADS FOR A US ECOMMERCE BRAND
We are a US-based ecommerce company hiring full-time remote video editors to produce short video ads (30–60 seconds) for Facebook and Instagram. This is a long-term, permanent full-time position — we are looking for people who want stable work with one company, not a short project. We are hiring MORE THAN ONE editor for this role. Work is fully remote.
THE ROLE
You will receive a complete package for every ad: a finished script, a creative brief, and example videos showing the style to match. Your job is to turn that package into a finished video ad:
- Generate AI video clips using image-to-video tools (we use Kling via Higgsfield — we provide all accounts and all tools, you pay for nothing)
- Generate the starting images for those clips with AI image tools, using prompts you develop with our AI assistant
- Source real B-roll clips from TikTok, YouTube, and similar platforms where the shot calls for it
- Generate the voiceover with AI (ElevenLabs) from the provided script
- Assemble everything in the editing software you are most comfortable with (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, etc.): edit to the voiceover, add captions, add music, export
- Each ad is delivered as three versions with different openings (we will train you on our exact method — it is fast once learned)
You do not write scripts and you do not need marketing knowledge. We provide the script, the brief, and the reference videos. You provide clean, fast, good-looking execution. Work is assigned and tracked through a simple board — you always know exactly what to work on next.
SCHEDULE AND PAY
Full-time, 8 hours per day, Monday to Saturday. USD $600–$1,200 per month depending on experience, fixed, paid reliably every month. Real opportunity for pay growth as your output proves itself — we are building a long-term creative team and this role grows with the company.
HOW TO APPLY
Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that skip any step will not be read.
1. Start your application message with the word KINGFISHER on the first line.
2. Include a link to your portfolio or showreel.
3. List the AI video/image tools you have personally used and one sentence on what you made with each. If you have used Claude or another AI assistant, say so and tell us what for.
4. Confirm you are available full-time, Monday to Saturday, and are applying as an individual.
5. Answer this short exercise. Imagine you are producing a video ad from a script we gave you. Four situations come up. For each one, tell us which ONE action you would take and give one sentence explaining why.
a) One line of the script feels awkward to you and you think you could word it better. Do you: REWRITE IT / FLAG IT AND BUILD IT AS WRITTEN / SKIP THAT LINE?
b) The example video we gave you for style reference features a well-known influencer talking to camera. Do you: CLIP HER FOOTAGE INTO OUR AD / RECREATE THE SAME STYLE OF SHOT WITH AN AI-GENERATED PERSON / ASK US TO LICENSE HER FOOTAGE?
c) An AI-generated clip looks great except the person's hands are warped. Do you: SHIP IT, VIEWERS WON'T NOTICE / REGENERATE THE CLIP WITH A FIXED PROMPT / CROP THE HANDS OUT IF POSSIBLE, OTHERWISE REGENERATE?
d) You need a generic clip of a dog running in a park and can't find good free footage. Do you: LEAVE THAT SHOT OUT / GENERATE IT WITH AI / USE A CLIP THAT ALMOST FITS?
Shortlisted candidates will have a short video interview, and final candidates will complete a SHORT PAID test project (we pay you for it). We read every application that follows the instructions.

An well known insurance client is looking for a Senior Network and Security Engineer to join their team in Sandton, GP   who is comfortable working in a busy, security-critical enterprise environment and can take ownership of network, firewall, Azure connectivity, monitoring, and datacentre network operations. The role requires strong hands-on FortiGate experience, proven Extreme Networks switching knowledge, practical Azure networking exposure, and the ability to keep a regulated financial services environment stable, secure, well documented, and ready for incident response or disaster recovery scenarios.
Role Purpose:
This is a hands-on engineering role with responsibility across datacentres, core network infrastructure, firewall
operations, hybrid cloud connectivity, monitoring, incident response, maintenance, documentation, vendor
engagement, and continuous improvement of the network estate. The person must be able to operate independently, act as a escalation point, and provide practical guidance to junior engineers while maintaining clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Responsibilities:
1. Enterprise Networking
• Design, implement, support, and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN, and datacentre network infrastructure.
• Support enterprise switching with a strong focus on Extreme Networks platforms.
• Configure and maintain VLANs, trunks, STP, redundancy, link aggregation, and resilient Layer 2 designs.
• Handle advanced routing and switching (OSPF, BGP, static routing, route redistribution, high availability failover).
• Troubleshoot performance, latency, packet loss, routing, STP, and connectivity issues.
• Act as an escalation point for complex network incidents and recurring issues.
• Contribute to network architecture decisions, standards, lifecycle refresh, and operational improvements.
2. Extreme Networks Switching
• Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Extreme Networks switches in production and datacentre environments.
• Support switch stacks, chassis, edge, core, and aggregation layer configurations.
• Maintain resilient connectivity via trunking, link aggregation, STP tuning, redundant uplinks, and failover paths.
• Investigate switch port errors, interface utilisation, duplex/speed mismatches, VLAN mismatches, and MAC learning issues.
• Maintain consistent configuration standards and back up switch configurations.
• Support planned maintenance, firmware upgrades, configuration changes, and switch replacements.
3. Firewall and Network Security (FortiGate Essential)
• Configure, manage, and maintain FortiGate firewalls across the enterprise.
• Own firewall policy and rule management (rule creation, optimisation, cleanup, NAT, UTM profiles, security policies).
• Configure and troubleshoot VPN solutions (site-to-site, remote access, third-party, cloud connectivity).
• Monitor firewall health, logs, sessions, interface utilisation, VPN tunnels, and security events.
• Investigate and resolve firewall-related incidents affecting applications, users, systems, vendors, or cloud connectivity.
• Support firewall hardening, segmentation, least-privilege access, and policy governance.
• Support security audits, evidence gathering, compliance requirements, and remediation in a regulated financial services environment.
• Work with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralised policy management, reporting, logging, and visibility.
• Experience with IPS, IDS, SSL inspection, web filtering, application control, and security event investigation is advantageous.
4. Azure Networking and Hybrid Cloud Connectivity
• Demonstrate practical Azure networking knowledge (VNets, subnets, NSGs, route tables, Azure DNS, private connectivity, hybrid access).
• Support hybrid networking between on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure.
• Troubleshoot Azure network routing, name resolution, firewall, NSG, private endpoint, and hybrid connectivity issues.
• Support Microsoft 365, Teams, Exchange Online, and Azure service connectivity from a firewall/network perspective.
• Work closely with cloud, server, security, and application teams to ensure secure, resilient, and well-documented cloud network architecture.
5. Monitoring, Alerting, and Observability
• Monitor network, firewall, wireless, cloud connectivity, and infrastructure health using enterprise tools.
• Investigate and resolve alerts related to availability, firewall health, interface utilisation, routing stability, VPN, wireless performance, and security events.
• Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, alert thresholds, operational reports, and health checks.
• Perform trend analysis and capacity planning to identify growth, availability, performance, and resilience risks.
• Maintain monitoring coverage for routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, VPNs, links, and cloud network services.
• Work with SNMP, syslog, ICMP checks, service checks, log forwarding, and alert escalation processes.
• Experience with Nagios is advantageous; exposure to PRTG, SolarWinds, Zabbix, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, or Azure Monitor is also valuable.
• Contribute to proactive monitoring improvements and service stability initiatives.
6. Wireless and Edge Networking
• Design, deploy, support, and troubleshoot enterprise WiFi (including high-density office environments).
• Support secure wireless authentication (WPA2, WPA3, 802.1x).
• Troubleshoot wireless performance, coverage, roaming, interference, and authentication issues.
• Maintain wireless standards, SSID configuration, guest access controls, and secure segmentation.
• Work with network access controls and secure edge access where applicable.
7. Datacentre, DR, and Resilience
• Support datacentre and DR network connectivity with a focus on availability, resilience, and failover readiness.
• Support redundant network paths, firewall failover, routing failover, VPN resilience, and DR network testing.

• Work closely with server, virtualisation, database, application, security, cloud, and service desk teams.
• Work with external vendors, ISPs, carriers, and technology partners to resolve incidents and deliver changes.

9. Documentation, Standards, and Knowledge Sharing

• Maintain practical standards for network, firewall, monitoring, and Azure networking.

• Ensure configuration backups, change records, and operational documentation are kept up to date.

job_title: Wine Sales Specialist Consultant | Meridian Wine Merchants | Gauteng
about_role:
Meridian Wine Merchants is currently seeking a passionate and results-driven individual to join our team as a Wine Sales Specialist Consultant. At Meridian Wine Merchants, we expertly combine tradition and innovation to provide outstanding products tailored to our diverse clients. This position is based in Gauteng.
Duties and Responsibilities
• Identify, develop and convert new premium business opportunities while growing premium wine sales, profitability and portfolio performance across allocated territories.
• Develop annual customer growth plans, identify new premium opportunities, and implement initiatives that expand premium category sales.
• Execute wine list recommendations, premium portfolio placements, and listing opportunities within targeted customer segments and outlets.
• Proactively identify, prospect and convert new premium restaurants, hotels, hospitality groups and specialist wine customers within the allocated territory.
• Develop trusted long-term client relationships that position Meridian as the preferred premium wine partner while expanding customer value.
• Conduct customer-led trade visits to identify execution opportunities, customer requirements, visibility gaps, and portfolio growth opportunities.
• Lead premium tastings, winemaker dinners, customer events and educational experiences that generate new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships.
• Develop customer-specific growth plans by identifying premium category opportunities, menu opportunities, new listings and premium portfolio expansion opportunities.
• Review customer wine offerings, identify gaps and growth opportunities, recommend commercially successful wine selections, and establish premium category standards.
• Gather and communicate customer insights, competitor activity, wine list trends, and regional market intelligence to support strategic commercial decisions.
• Identify new premium trading areas, emerging customer segments and untapped market opportunities for future business growth.
• Execute customer and portfolio segmentation strategies to ensure the right portfolio mix within the right customer environments.
• Execute cycle briefs, premium trade initiatives, promotional campaigns, and activation plans in conjunction with Trade Marketing and the Wine Specialist Manager.
• Work closely with Distribution, Trade Marketing, Key Accounts, Sales Reps, Finance, and internal support teams to ensure product availability and operational execution.
• Coach Sales Representatives on premium portfolio positioning, customer opportunities and premium selling techniques.
• Deliver premium wine education, food pairing guidance and category development sessions that strengthen customer capability and drive premium wine sales.
• Ensure disciplined usage and maintenance of Repforce, Truedata, reporting tools, and customer databases.
• Continuously maintain and improve wine, competitor, portfolio, commercial and premium category knowledge.
Requirements
• Grade 12 (Matric) plus Cape Wine Academy Wine Certificate
• Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FMCG liquor sales and merchandising across premium customer environments
• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, CG Cloud) advantageous
• Valid driver’s licence, own reliable vehicle, and right to work in South Africa
Why Join Meridian?
Meridian Wine Merchants connects some of South Africa's most exciting premium wine brands with the country's leading restaurants, retailers, hotels and wine professionals. Every day is an opportunity to learn, grow and make an impact in an industry we're passionate about.
We're a team that works hard, celebrates success and is always looking for better ways to do things. We value people who bring energy, curiosity, integrity and a genuine love for wine. Here, your ideas matter, your contribution is recognised, and your growth is part of our success.
If you're passionate about premium wine, thrive in a fast-moving environment and want to build a career where you'll be challenged, supported and inspired every day, come and grow with us.

job_title: Office Services and Maintenance / Facilities Manager
about_role:
National Brands Limited (NBL), a leading subsidiary of AVI Limited, is one of South Africa’s top FMCG companies with iconic brands like Willards, Bakers, Five Roses, and House of Coffees. For over 173 years, NBL has been a key player in the South African food sector, expanding its reach across Southern Africa and delivering high-quality products that impact daily lives.
At NBL, we embrace a culture of high standards, teamwork, and accountability. Our employees are driven by excellence and innovation, always prioritising customer satisfaction. We celebrate our South African roots and foster a workplace where collaboration thrive.
Step Into a Role That Makes an Impact! We’re seeking a Office Services and Maintenance Manager to drive success NBL Head Office in Bryanston, Johannesburg. This role is designed to ensure ensure maximum, efficient operation of facilities and equipment, as well as the care of the Bryanston Campus building, grounds and support equipment, through the direction of support staff made up of supervisors, technicians and custodians.  Develops and maintains preventative maintenance programs. Sets priorities for projects and enforces safety and housekeeping practices.
Reporting Structure:
• Reports to: AVI Exco Project Manager
• Direct Reports: Maintenance Supervisor, Post room Supervisor / Post room attendant and driver, 2x Baristas, Telephonist, Staff shop and AdministrationKey Areas of Impact:
Ensure a functional, safe and compliant facilities infrastructure:
• Minimise operational, safety, and infrastructure risk across the Bryanston Campus
• Ensure compliance with all relevant legislation, standards, and internal governance requirements relating to facilities and building infrastructure.
• Maintain oversight of statutory inspections, certifications, and compliance documentation.
• Identify and escalate risks timeously, ensuring corrective actions are implemented and tracked.
• Stay informed of technical developments, legislative changes, and industry best practices affecting facilities management.
• Ensure prompt logging, tracking, and resolution of all maintenance requests and complaints.
• Implement structured reactive and preventive maintenance processes.
• Monitor building systems including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, and fire services.
• Identify infrastructure risks and implement corrective and preventative actions.
• Ensure operational continuity and minimise business disruption.
• Compile monthly Facilities Report which documents all of the above mentioned items. Asset Management:
• Ensure the effective, efficient and optimal utilisation of all facilities assets in line with asset-care principles.
• Implement and maintain planned and preventive maintenance schedules to protect asset condition and extend useful life.
• Monitor asset performance and condition to support proactive maintenance and replacement planning.
• Prepare and manage asset replacement forecasts and lifecycle budgets in alignment with business planning cycles.
• Identify and implement cost-saving and value-optimisation opportunities without compromising safety or service levels.
• Review and verify supplier quotations, variation orders, and final invoices to ensure accuracy.
• Monitor, track and record the movements of assets.
• Monitor and maintain records of warranties, service contracts, compliance certificates, and maintenance history.Ensure compliance to Health and Safety in line with OHSA:
• Ensure ongoing compliance with OHSA and related statutory requirements.
• Maintain emergency preparedness and business continuity plans, including documentation, drills, and reviews.
• Monitor, investigate, and report all facilities-related incidents and alerts to Executive Management.
• Ensure appointment and training of health and safety representatives, fire marshals, and first aiders.
• Ensure completion of monthly safety inspections and statutory meetings.
• Support audits, risk assessments, and corrective action tracking.Ensure a safe, neat and hygienic working environment for staff:
• Manage daily campus operations to ensure a safe, clean and efficient working environment.
• Conduct regular inspections and audits, ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
• Ensure facilities requests and complaints are logged and resolved timeously.
• Source vendors, obtain quotations and recommend preferred suppliers.
• Coordinate weekend and after-hours contractor activities.
• Manage campus-wide communications related to facilities operations.
• Maintain up-to-date campus documentation, site guides and SOPs.Ensure Accurate Reporting and Financial Control (budgets and actuals):
• Prepare and manage operational budgets, including day-to-day costs, revise monthly building expenditure.
• Monitor monthly expenditure and update forecasts.
• Analyse and report budget variances to the AVI Exco Projects Manager.
• Review and approve invoices to ensure cost accuracy and budget compliance.
• Maintain accurate financial reporting and audit documentation. Delivery of ad-hoc projects:
• Plan and deliver ad-hoc facilities projects in line with business requirements.
• Manage scope, cost, quality, timelines and contractor performance.
• Ensure compliance with safety, governance and procurement standards.
• Coordinate stakeholder communication and project close-out documentationEffective team management:
• Lead and manage the facilities team to ensure effective service delivery.
• Set performance objectives and conduct regular performance reviews (set IPA’s, Mid year and Year End reviews, manage poor performance).
• Identify training and development needs.
• Ensure compliance with company policies and safety standards.
• Promote teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement. Knowledge and Skills:
• Health and Safety Audit Knowledge
• Facilities Management Protocols and Procedures
• Knowledge of OHSACT
• Project planning, delivery management
• Budgeting and Financial Management
• Asset Management
• Candidate must be willing to work overtime.  Professional Affiliations:
• South African Facilities Manager Association (SAFMA) What It Takes to Succeed:
Experience that set you up for success:
• 5 – 6 years in Facility Management
• 5 – 6 years Managing direct reports
• 5 – 6 years Supervising contractors and technicians
• 5 – 6 years of Budget management experience
• 5 – 6 years of Asset management Qualifications & Certifications that will contribute to your success:
• Grade 12 / Matric
• Facilities Management qualification

African Parks is a non-profit conservation organization that takes on the complete responsibility for the rehabilitation and long-term management of national parks in partnership with governments and local communities. We currently manage 23 national parks and protected areas in 13 countries covering over 20 million hectares in: Angola, Benin, Central African Republic, Chad, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Malawi, Mozambique, Republic of Congo, Rwanda, Zambia, Zimbabwe, South Sudan and Ethiopia.
The Great Nile Migration Landscape (GNML) in South Sudan spans over 120,000 km² across Badingilo and Boma National Parks, Jonglei State, and adjoining community lands. It forms one of Africa’s most important ecological systems, connecting the Sudd wetlands in the west to the Boma highlands in the east. The landscape supports extraordinary biodiversity, including the largest land mammal migration on earth comprising around 6 million animals.
JOB OVERVIEW:
The ICM is responsible for developing, in accordance with relevant African Parks SOPs
and in close collaboration with the AP ICPM, individual but linked information coordination functions for Boma NP, Jonglei Project and Bandigilo NP.
MAIN ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Set up, train and mentor the two teams in information collection and analysis techniques.
o Select and hire of both investigators and analysts.
o Assist during the basic training of both the investigators and analysts.
o Provide continued mentorship during the day-to-day work and operations of the teams in the four parks.
• Develop and maintain each park’s information coordination functions
o Focus analytical work and assure reporting standards
o Supervise collection/investigative efforts
• Supervise day-to-day work of park-level teams, including but not limited to work schedules, human resource requirements and personnel development, and other such activities as may be required or requested by the park manager.
• Ensure that the information coordination database is managed correctly and kept up-to-date.
o Ensure that all sensitive data is stored in a secure manner
• Develop and maintain relationships with other AP parks, key stakeholders, and partner organizations, including but not limited to those involved in security assessment and the investigation of wildlife crime-related matters.
• Assess material and equipment needs and lead procurement efforts for identified needs of all teams.
Academic & experience required.
1. Experienced working in information collection and/or information analysis required, preferably in a managerial role.
2. Experience with geographic information systems (GIS) and social network analysis (SNA) software.
3. Able to self-manage and understand priorities in a fast-paced environment.
4. Fluency in spoken and written English and ability to write detailed and accurate reports with clarity, brevity and timeliness.
5. Able to self-manage and understand priorities
6. Good team player with a collaborative spirit.
7. Excellent communication skills and ability to work with diverse cultures.
8. Experience living and working in austere environments.

JOB PURPOSE:
To fabricate, assemble, repair and service mechanical equipment/systems towards ensuring equipment reliability and plant availability, in a safe and cost-effective manner and compliance with applicable policies, procedures and regulatory statutes.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Equipment Assembling / Installations & Commissioning
· A  Analyse and interpret blueprints of mechanical equipment/systems (diagrams, drawings, specifications & plans to determine suitable material and sequence of operations).
·     Measure and mark out materials for fabrication
·     Fabricate and/or construct structural components, monitor process and adjust settings
·     Inspect fabricated components make corrective changes where necessary
·     Assemble and fit fabricated components into tools, equipment or systems
·     Keep record of all installation activities
·     Participate in equipment/system commissioning to ensure that the equipment/system is in good and safe functional condition.
·     Hand over equipment/system to relevant stakeholders.
Mechanical Maintenance (Predictive / Preventative / Corrective and Shutdown)
·    Liaise with Maintenance Planner or other relevant stakeholders to ensure availability of critical spares and equipment.
·    Ensure adequate inventory/availability of necessary spares and/or supplies.
·    Create suitable maintenance schedules in liaison with production management.
·    Perform preventative and corrective maintenance activities as per Plant Safety Regulations, preventative maintenance plans and maintenance procedure
·    Conduct maintenance as per Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) maintenance procedure.
·    Ensure personal and team members' safety.
·   Perform plant Shutdown work as per shutdown plan.
·   Conduct fault-finding and problem-solving on mechanical, hydraulic, pumps and pneumatic equipments.
·    Conduct overhauling of all mechanical equipments.
·    Attend to breakdowns, conduct PM's, perform standby duties and after hours' callouts as and when necessary.
·    Ensure that all machinery complies with General Machinery Regulations (GMR) and that all work is done in accordance with relevant SANS codes.
·    Uphold and maintain quality standards and ensure that customer requirements are addressed.
·    Ensure that equipment/machines produce products that are within quality specifications and address non-conformances that are caused by mechanical mal functioning.
·    Report operational non-conformances to relevant stakeholders to ensure that plants run with minimum breakdowns.
Condition Monitoring
·     Inspect and monitor the conditions of equipment regularly and record accordingly as per Planned Maintenance schedule and submit report to management.
·    Interpret deviations recorded and take corrective actions to rectify when applicable.
·    Inspect conveyors, pipes and tanks
·    Take and maintain vibration monitoring records for all critical plant rotating equipment
Compliance to all Safety, Health, Environment, Risk, Quality & Food Safety (SHERQFS) Standards and Regulations
·    Maintain cleanliness of equipment and work area.
·    Ensure that housekeeping activities conform to Food Safety Regulations.
·    Conduct safety checks on all machinery and tools and ensure completion of safety checklists as required.
·    Comply with Company SHERQFS procedures and instructions. '
·    Report all health and safety and food safety risks and problems.
·    Collaborate with SHERQFS personnel when implementing remedial actions.
·    Attend to emergency situations in accordance to procedures such.
Maintenance Procedures & Training
·     Provide input into maintenance Standard Operating Procedures.
·     Train colleagues/apprentices to install, maintain or repair mechanical equipment and systems, and on SOPs as and when applicable.
Continuous Improvement
·     Identify opportunities for improvement of plant performance.
·     Initiate and implement improvement programs and initiatives as approved by management.

job_title: Performance Marketing Lead — Meta / Facebook Ads
about_role:
We're looking for an exceptional Meta media buyer who operates the way the best marketers will operate in 2026: with AI in the loop at every step. You'll own high-volume Facebook and Instagram campaigns end to end — strategy, creative production, launch, and optimisation — with aggressive CPA targets and real budget authority.
This is not a role for someone who dabbles with ChatGPT for ad copy. We want someone who has rebuilt their entire workflow around AI: driving campaign optimisation programmatically through the Meta Ads API and MCP-connected agents, generating and iterating video creative with AI tools in hours rather than weeks, and letting data — not habit — decide what runs.
What You'll Do
• Own high-volume campaigns — plan, launch, and scale Meta campaigns across multiple ad accounts, owning performance against tight CPA and ROAS targets.
• Optimise with AI in the loop — build and run agentic workflows (MCP servers, Meta Ads API, custom scripts, or tools like Claude) that monitor spend, surface anomalies, rotate creative, and execute budget and bid changes at a pace no manual buyer can match.
• Create video at speed — produce ad videos on the fly using AI video generation and editing tools (e.g. Runway, Veo, Sora, Kling, HeyGen, CapCut and similar), turning a creative brief into live test variants same-day.
• Handle editing and banner design — cut, caption, resize, and version video for placements; design static banners and image ads to a standard good enough to ship without a designer in the loop.
• Run a rigorous testing programme — structure high-tempo creative testing — hooks, formats, angles, audiences — and feed the results back into both the creative pipeline and the account structure.
• Stay on top of the data — own tracking, attribution (Pixel, CAPI, post-back), reporting, and the numbers behind every decision. You should be able to explain any account's performance from memory.
• Build the playbook — document what works, systematise it, and raise the bar for how the whole company buys media

Our client, a leading logistics and supply chain solutions provider, is seeking a proactive and hands-on HSEQ Officer to join their Durban operation.
The successful candidate will primarily support food-grade warehouse operations, while also providing HSEQ support across transport and logistics operations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being out in the operation, conducting inspections, engaging with employees and contractors, and ensuring Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality and Food Safety standards are maintained.
Minimum Requirements
• Grade 12 (Matric).
• Health & Safety Certificate (essential).
• Minimum 2-4 years' HSEQ, SHEQ or Safety Officer experience.
• Previous experience conducting site inspections, incident investigations and supporting audit preparation.
• Experience within logistics, warehousing, transport or supply chain operations.
• Valid driver's licence.
• Good computer literacy (Microsoft Office).
• Willingness to travel between operational sites as required.
• Willingness to work overtime or after hours when operational requirements dictate.
Key Responsibilities
• Conduct daily HSEQ inspections across warehouse, yard and operational areas.
• Identify, report and follow up on hazards, unsafe acts, incidents and near misses.
• Assist with incident investigations and implement corrective and preventative actions.
• Monitor compliance with HSEQ procedures, site rules and PPE requirements.
• Conduct toolbox talks, safety briefings and employee/contractor inductions.
• Support internal and external audit preparation by maintaining accurate records and documentation.
• Complete HSEQ reports, registers, inspections and compliance checklists.
• Monitor housekeeping, hygiene, waste management, spill control and environmental compliance.
• Support food safety, hygiene, product protection and quality standards within food-grade warehouse operations.
• Monitor contractor and driver compliance with site requirements.
• Assist with risk assessments and continuous improvement initiatives.
Highly Advantageous
• SAMTRAC or equivalent qualification.
• Experience within an FMCG, food manufacturing or food-grade warehousing environment.
• Knowledge of food safety systems, hygiene standards, HACCP, GMP, PRPs and product protection.
• Exposure to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
• Experience working with contractor management and transport operations.
Key Competencies
• Excellent attention to detail.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Assertive with the confidence to address unsafe behaviour.
• Strong administrative and organisational skills.
• Ability to build effective working relationships across all levels.
• Excellent problem-solving and follow-up skills.
• Professional, reliable and committed to maintaining high HSEQ standards.
If you are passionate about workplace safety, operational compliance and food safety within a fast-paced logistics environment, we would love to hear from you.

With more than 34400 students, and approximately 1700 members of staff, the Durban University of Technology (DUT) is a leading university of technology proudly located in the beautiful cities of Durban and Pietermaritzburg, along the warm east coast of South Africa. Founded in April 2002 through the historic merger of the former ML Sultan Technikon and Technikon Natal, DUT has evolved into a modern, metropolitan, multi-campus university with roots tracing back to 1907.
Today, DUT is recognised nationally and internationally for its excellence in teaching and learning, research, innovation, entrepreneurship and engagement. A proud member of the International Association of Universities, DUT continues to expand its influence across South Africa and the world. In the 2025 Webometrics Rankings, DUT was ranked among the Top 6% of all universities and colleges worldwide, reflecting its academic excellence, research impact and strong global visibility.
DUT’s Philosophy of Education, “Our creativity and innovation shapes adaptive graduates who transform society” reflects the institution’s deep commitment to meaningful impact for societal transformation. Guided by its inspirational and aspirational ENVISION2030 strategy, which is rooted in DUT’s DNA of being ‘people-centred and engaged’ and ‘innovative and entrepreneurial’ and underpinned by its bespoke Living Values Framework, DUT focuses on ‘contributing to the improvement of lives and livelihoods’.
The University comprises six diverse Faculties:
• Accounting and Informatics
• Applied Science
• Arts & Design
• Engineering and the Built Environment
• Health Sciences
• Management Sciences
DUT also includes a Business School and the award-winning Institute for Water and Wastewater Technology (IWWT), amongst other research centres and institutes, reinforcing its role as a hub for knowledge, innovation and societal impact. Over the years, the University substantially grown its research output, dominating the UoT sector. This is evidenced by the steady increase of NRF-rated researchers and the notable, unprecedented award of seven NRF SARCHi Chairs in 2025. This impetus helps us to remain deeply engaged with our communities glocally, thereby transforming societies and economies.
At DUT, we believe in nurturing talent and empowering people to make a real difference. If you are passionate about contributing to education, research, innovation, entrepreneurship and engagement, DUT offers the ideal environment - Creative. Distinctive. Impactful.

Readvertisement: Researcher/Senior Researcher in Accumulation and Inequalities in the Rhodes African Studies Centre (RASC)
(Contract post – 2 years)
The Rhodes African Studies Centre invites suitably qualified candidates to join their team.
The Rhodes Africa Studies Centre (RASC)
Established in 2019, the Rhodes African Studies Centre is an inter-faculty research Centre of Excellence that is located in the Faculty of Humanities at Rhodes University. It focuses on conceptual, methodological, and empirical ways of reconfiguring African studies. The Centre is an integral part of Africa Multiple, an initiative of the DFG’s Excellence strategy. Africa Multiple comprises the University of Bayreuth in Germany; Moi University in Kenya; University of Lagos in Nigeria and the University of Joseph Ki Zerbo in Burkina Faso, in addition to University of Salvador du Bahia, which is one of our partners. For more information, visit Africa Multiple at: https://www.africamultiple.uni-bayreuth.de/en/index.html
Main Objectives
Research is the main focus, and teaching is not a core function.  Where the researchers are on contract, raising funds for their employment, contract research shall be regarded as equivalent to more traditional forms of research.
In assessing the candidate’s scholarship for promotion, consideration will be given to the individual's track record.  While disciplinary differences are considered, the candidate must demonstrate standing within the discipline through their research and student research.  This could mean that the individual has demonstrated leadership, made a major contribution to research projects, served as the lead author on publications, or consistently contributed to multiple publications throughout their academic career.
The Requirements
Researcher
• A PhD in African Studies, Political Economy, Economics, Political Sciences, Sociology, Science and Technology Studies, Gender Studies, Anthropology, Geography, Urban Planning, History, Cultural Studies, or a related field.
• Some experience in areas related to accumulation and inequality research, as well as political economy thinking; a focus on the gendered nature of accumulation dynamics is desirable.
• Emerging publication profile in leading journals with a reference to the themes "accumulation" and "inequality". A strong monograph by a respected publisher can be credited as an alternative. The publications address inter- and/or transdisciplinary research projects and build on proven collaborations relevant to the theme of accumulation and inequalities.
• Postgraduate research supervision is not necessarily required. Those with such experience have an added advantage.
• Some experience in coordinating or organising interdisciplinary and/or collaborative projects and/or programmes (this may include conferences and related academic activities)
• Evidence of attendance and presentation at local conferences. Presentation at international conferences will be an added advantage.
• A scholar showing significant research potential.
• Administrative experience, including the ability to coordinate a team of scholars in a collaborative international and interdisciplinary research context.
Senior Researcher
• A PhD in African Studies, Political Economy, Economics, Political Sciences, Sociology, Science and Technology Studies, Gender Studies, Anthropology, Geography, Urban Planning, History, Cultural Studies, or a related field.
• Significant expertise and experience in areas related to accumulation and inequality research, as well as political economy thinking; a focus on the gendered nature of accumulation dynamics is desirable.
• A very good publication record in leading journals with a reference to the themes "accumulation" and "inequality". A strong monograph by a respected publisher can be credited as an alternative. The publications should address inter- and transdisciplinary research projects and build on proven collaborations relevant to the theme of accumulation and inequalities.
• Research supervision of at least a Master’s degree is required. Supervision at the PhD level will be an added advantage.
• Significant experience in leading and/or coordinating interdisciplinary and/or collaborative research projects and/or programmes.
• Evidence of attendance and presentation in local and preferably international conferences.
• An established researcher with an emerging national profile in the discipline.
• Track record of administration, management, and/or leadership roles (leadership roles may be informal) in a collaborative international and interdisciplinary research context.

• Reasons for leaving your current and previous jobs.

Role Purpose:
The Lending Dealmaker will be required to originate, structure, negotiate and execute profitable lending (Working Capital, Commercial Property finance and Term Loan) and structured finance transactions for mid-market corporate clients by developing trusted client relationships, identifying funding opportunities and coordinating internal stakeholders through to successful financial close.
The Transactor is accountable for the entire client lifecycle, from business development and opportunity identification through credit approval, execution, drawdown and ongoing portfolio management; while balancing client needs, commercial returns and prudent risk management
Main Accountabilities:
• Origination
• Originate and develop quality lending opportunities that align with Merchant West's strategic objectives, risk appetite and return requirements.
• Develop and maintain a sustainable pipeline of bankable transactions through proactive business development, referrals and relationship management.
• Identify, engage and convert new clients while deepening relationships with existing clients and strategic partners.
• Understand clients' funding requirements and develop bespoke financing solutions that create long-term value.
• Market, present and articulate credit opportunities to internal stakeholders, Credit Committees, institutional funders and other capital providers.
• Coordinate and manage the end-to-end transaction process from initial engagement through credit approval, documentation and funding.
• Prepare high-quality term sheets, transaction proposals, credit papers, investment memoranda, client presentations and other supporting documentation.
• Transaction Structuring
• Structure innovative and commercially viable financing solutions that balance client requirements with Merchant West's risk and return objectives.
• Develop funding structures suitable for institutional investors and other funding partners.
• Assess alternative financing structures and recommend the most appropriate solution based on commercial, legal, tax and funding considerations.
• Work collaboratively with Credit, Legal, Treasury and external advisers to optimise transaction structures and facilitate successful execution.
• Contribute to product development, process improvements and strategic initiatives as required.
• Transaction Execution and Portfolio Management
• Manage the successful implementation of approved transactions through close coordination with Credit, Legal, Operations, Treasury and external stakeholders.
• Ensure legal documentation accurately reflects approved commercial terms and all conditions precedent are satisfied prior to funding.
• Oversee transaction drawdown and successful financial close.
• Monitor the ongoing performance of the portfolio through financial reviews, covenant monitoring and proactive client engagement.
• Identify emerging credit risks and implement appropriate remedial actions where required.
• Maintain awareness of economic, industry and regulatory developments that may impact client performance and portfolio quality.
• Credit Evaluation & Assessment
• Conduct comprehensive commercial, financial and credit assessments of prospective transactions.
• Analyse historical and forecast financial information, cash flows, repayment capacity, management capability, industry dynamics and security structures.
• Identify key transaction risks and develop appropriate mitigants and structural protections.
• Prepare clear, balanced and well-supported credit recommendations for approval.
• Apply sound commercial judgement when evaluating pricing, risk-adjusted returns, return on equity (ROE), capital utilisation, portfolio concentration, correlation risk and overall transaction profitability.
• Relationship Management
• Develop and maintain trusted relationships with clients, introducers, institutional investors, professional advisers and internal stakeholders.
• Build a strong internal network across Origination, Credit, Legal, Treasury, Finance and Operations to facilitate efficient transaction execution.
• Act as a trusted adviser by developing a thorough understanding of clients' businesses, industries and strategic objectives.
• Deliver exceptional client service while maintaining an appropriate balance between commercial opportunity and prudent risk management.
• Represent Merchant West professionally, demonstrating the highest standards of integrity, accountability and collaboration..
Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree, Finance, Accounting, Economics or Commerce.
• Postgraduate qualification such as a CA(SA), CFA Charter, MBA or Master's degree in Finance, Business or a related field (advantageous).
Experience:
• 2 – 4 years in a lending and Dealmaker environment.
• Demonstrated experience in corporate banking, commercial banking, structured finance, leveraged finance, asset finance, private credit or business banking, with a proven ability to originate, structure and execute debt transactions.
• Demonstrated experience in corporate banking, commercial banking, structured finance, leveraged finance, asset finance, private credit or business banking, with a proven ability to originate, structure and execute debt transactions.
• Demonstrated experience in corporate credit and lending environments, including credit underwriting, financial statement analysis, cash flow forecasting and financial modelling, debt structuring and pricing, assessment of security and collateral arrangements, preparation and review of loan documentation (including term sheets, facility agreements, and security documentation), and negotiation of commercial and legal terms with clients, legal advisers, and other stakeholders
• Experience engaging directly with entrepreneurs, business owners, financial directors, accountants and professional advisers.
• Experience presenting transactions to Credit Committees and managing deals through approval, documentation and financial close.
• Experience within corporate credit, specialised finance, structured lending, commercial banking or private debt markets is highly advantageous.
• An established professional network capable of generating new business opportunities will be advantageous.

Salary: Market Related (Cost to Company, negotiable based on experience)

This is a rare opportunity to do work that genuinely matters. A women's health research team based at a public hospital in Westdene, Johannesburg, operates through a clinical research unit focused on cervical cancer prevention and sexual and reproductive health. The team runs rigorous, protocol-driven clinical trials, with a strong track record of meaningful research in women's health, including work with women living with HIV. The environment is academic, purpose-led, and deeply committed to advancing health outcomes for women in South Africa.
This is not a routine nursing role. The successful candidate will play a central part in bringing a new clinical trial to life, from recruiting and enrolling participants through to managing study visits, collecting and processing specimens, and maintaining the kind of meticulous documentation that good clinical research demands. If you thrive in a structured yet fast-moving environment, enjoy working across clinic, pharmacy, and lab teams, and want your clinical skills to contribute directly to research that reaches real communities, this role was built for you.
What's in it for you
Be part of meaningful, purpose-driven research focused on cervical cancer prevention and women's health.
Join a well-regarded, experienced research team with a history of high-quality clinical trials.
Build and apply a rare combination of clinical and research skills in a single role.
Work in an academic environment that values precision, initiative, and continuous learning.
Contribute findings that are shared with community stakeholders and have real-world impact.
Minimum Requirements
Registered professional nurse, enrolled nurse, or equivalent qualification recognised by the South African Nursing Council.
Active registration with the South African Nursing Council at the time of application.
Valid Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification and training in the protection of human subjects.
Minimum two years of experience in clinical research or public health.
Spoken and written fluency in English and IsiZulu or Sesotho.
Strong computer literacy with solid writing and presentation skills.
Demonstrated experience in clinical research.
Demonstrated experience in cancer, sexual and reproductive health, or HIV programmes.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and data capture.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and take initiative.
Clinical experience in women's sexual and reproductive health services such as Pap smear screening, STI screening, or family planning is a strong advantage.
Prior experience in clinical trials is advantageous.
Valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification is advantageous.
Willingness to work overtime or weekends when required.
Key Responsibilities
Assist the study coordinator and investigators with planning, setting up, and managing day-to-day clinical trial activities in line with the approved protocol, GCP, and SOPs.
Recruit participants and support screening, enrolment, and ongoing retention through follow-up, reminder calls, and tracing of participants lost to follow-up.
Administer and accurately document informed consent for all study participants.
Schedule and coordinate study visits, liaising with clinic, pharmacy, and laboratory staff to ensure smooth visit flow.
Provide health education to participants, including HIV pre- and post-test counselling and results counselling.
Perform study procedures including vital signs, phlebotomy, pregnancy tests, pelvic examinations, Pap smears, HPV tests, and STI tests.
Administer investigational products or study drugs as directed.
Support collection, processing, labelling, storage, and tracking of all biological specimens.
Maintain accurate, complete, and contemporaneous source documents, case report forms, study logs, and participant records.
Capture study data into the electronic data capture system, resolve data queries, and support quality control of records.
Assist with assessing, documenting, and reporting adverse events and protocol deviations to the study coordinator and investigators.
Help maintain the investigator site file and support readiness for monitoring visits, audits, and regulatory reporting.
Assist with preparing study-related reports, presentations, and educational materials, and share findings with community stakeholders as requested.
Provide routine clinical care as requested.

Research Nurse, Clinical Trials, GCP, Women's Health, Cervical Cancer, Pap Smear, HPV, Pelvic Examination, Phlebotomy, SANC, Informed Consent, EDC, CRF, STI, Reproductive Health, Clinical Research, Public Health, IsiZulu, Sesotho, Westdene, Johannesburg
